notes: Java getDefaultDimensions (TheQueen.java:420-427) returns 16x12 full-size / 5.5x6 nice, but MHLib's EntityEvent.Size handler (de/dertoaster/multihitboxlib/EntityEventHandler.java:28-38) replaces the dims with the profile main-hitbox.size [22,24] (the_queen.json) for every IMultipartEntity whose profile resolves — TheQueen has no ICustomHitboxProfileSupplier opt-out (SpiderRobot/AntRobot do). NeoForge fires the event from Entity#<init> and refreshDimensions() (MixinLivingEntity.java:71-72 names the ctor-time firing). Expected runtime: 22x24 in BOTH modes => full size matches 1.7.10 only via the hook (the Java 16x12 is a latent fallback if the profile ever fails to resolve, e.g. datapack reload window), and the BOSS-017 PlayNicely 5.5x6 is DEAD (1.7.10 TheQueen.java:81). No test pins Queen dims (ConfigGateTests.boss017_play_nicely_gates pins only the King). Fix options (batch 3, lockstep): (a) opt out of the profile main size while playNicelyShrunk (implement ICustomHitboxProfileSupplier -> Optional.empty(), the classic-robot pattern; loses the bone parts while nice, which is what the orig single-box nice Queen had) or (b) set profile main-hitbox.size to [0,0] so the hook returns early (EntityEventHandler.java:34) and make getDefaultDimensions return 22x24 / 5.5x6. Either way the profile 'size' field and the Java dims must move together and a both-modes runtime pin (getBbWidth/Height after spawn) is required — this row cannot be closed from source reads alone.
